title: Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation

release_status.value: Official data-generation, generator, tracker, orchestrator and system code available. No trained HALO generator/tracker weights or complete datasets ship. Released data generation covers sit-on-chair; other skills require additional data. Multi-task example defaults differ from paper.

evidence_boundaries: No per-episode human teleoperation does not mean no human motion sources: G1 logs, phone video keyframes via GVHMR/GMR, recorded push and retargeted LAFAN1 are used
Kinematic reference rendering and geometric filtering do not guarantee physically valid data; SIT retains best chains after bounded retries even if checks fail
Zero-shot transfer excludes target-environment training/scans but hardware system identification uses real robot measurements
Only six skill datasets and ten fixed corpus instructions; free-form requests are mapped by a pretrained orchestrator to a finite skill set
91 percent real success is 360 single-task trials across six environments; multi-task is 70 percent over 30 trials in one real environment
All reported stage-wise ablations evaluate SIT in simulation
Regression comparison also loses the current RTC mechanism
1000 training rooms is a headline count; DOOR uses 966 multi-room scenes
No trained generator or tracker checkpoints or complete dataset ship with official repository
Released datagen focuses on SIT; other task training data and push object trajectories missing
Released multi-task demo uses proprio tracker and 0.4 second generation interval, not a verified full paper evaluation recipe
Frozen vs fine-tuned VLM observations in Appendix G are not systematic quantitative ablations
